glosses: To disconnect from a supply, especially an electrical socket.

examples.text: To save electricity, I unplug my computer when I am not at home.

glosses: To stop using electronic devices, especially for relaxation or to reduce stress.

examples.text: I need to unplug and spend some time with my family.
